_doc: Staff personal lives (StaffLifeManager). Each employee gets a family, money situation, fear and dream. Events fire at the start of a day (at most one), delivered as COMMS with choices. kind single = one employee {name}; pair = two at the same clinic {name} and {other}. cond keys: family, money, ethics_any, trait_any, spec_any, min_stress, min_rel, max_rel, bond, counter (story counter > 0), min_jobs. staff effects: a / b: loyalty, stress, rest, appearance, memory, life (set life fields), ethic (add); bond: state for the pair; rel: change between the pair. effects: StoryManager effects (money, rep, heat, dims, supplies).

none.label: Nobody. Says that's how they like it.

sister.label: A kid sister in the Sump they put through school

father.label: An old father with a failing lung

kid.label: A kid, and an ex who wants more money

partner.label: A partner who works corporate security

crew.label: An old gang crew they still drink with

saving.label: Saving every credit to leave the city

sending.label: Sends most of their pay home

fears: Corporate security finding their old file
The gangs that run their block
Turning into the chrome they install
dreams: Building something that doesn't kill people
Being the best cutter in the city
Getting their family out of the Sump

events.subject: {name} needs tomorrow
events.body: {name} catches you by the sink. "My {who} is in the ward on Kessler. They won't treat without a deposit. I need tomorrow, doc."

events.subject: Men outside, asking for {name}
events.body: Two men in long coats lean on your door. "{name} owes us three hundred. We can wait. Not long." {name} won't look at you.

events.subject: {name} closes the door
events.body: "The chrome we put in today had no serial. Somebody died for it, probably. I didn't sign up to be a fence with a scalpel."

events.subject: {name} wants a prototype
events.body: {name} turns a prototype optic over in their fingers. "Unregistered, faster than anything uptown. I'd be a better surgeon with it. Let me put it in. Tonight."

events.subject: {name} is shaking
events.body: {name}'s hands won't stay still over the tray. They haven't slept in two days and they're pretending it's the coffee.

events.subject: Synth-cake in the prep room
events.body: {name}'s {who} passed the academy exam. There's synth-cake on the instrument tray and nobody is complaining.

events.subject: {name}'s partner asks questions
events.body: {name}'s partner works corporate security. Last night they asked where all the unregistered chrome is coming from. {name} looks scared.

events.subject: Shouting in the prep room
events.body: {name} and {other} are shouting about who botched the last suture. Everyone in the waiting room can hear it.

events.subject: Two surgeons, one chair
events.body: {name} timed {other}'s last install and pinned the number on the wall. {other} has started coming in an hour early.

events.subject: {name} and {other}
events.body: {name} and {other} have been leaving together. They think nobody noticed. Everybody noticed.

events.subject: {name} and {other} aren't speaking
events.body: Whatever {name} and {other} had is over. They pass instruments without looking at each other and the patients can feel it.

events.subject: {name} has a theory
events.body: {name} says {other} makes calls from the alley after every black-market job. "Somebody's listening to us, doc."
